d:
Blood sugar is influenced by more than just the food on your plate. Physical activity, sleep, stress and daily routines all play a role in glucose regulation and metabolic health. In this video, Hansaji shares a practical 21-day routine to help you build healthier habits that support blood sugar management.
What you will learn:
1. How a calm morning routine and regular daylight exposure can support a healthy sleep-wake rhythm.
2. How methi (fenugreek) seeds may help with glucose regulation and why caution is needed if you take diabetes medication.
